result.rationale: Verifiable in the diff: the model's before_validation only strips scheme and path (`self.host.sub!(...)`), never lowercases, and the validation regex uses /i so 'EvilTrout.com' passes. record_for_host does `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` with `host = uri.host`, which is not lowercased. Thus a stored mixed-case host fails to match a referer with the same case, breaking embedding for a legitimately configured host.

judged_text: record_for_host compares `lower(host)` against a non-lowercased `uri.host`, while the write path (before_validation) strips scheme/path but never lowercases, so mixed-case stored hosts never match mixed-case referers. An admin saves host 'EvilTrout.com' (the format regex is /i so it validates), then a page on http://EvilTrout.com embeds: `where("lower(host) = ?", 'EvilTrout.com')` finds no row, embed comments return InvalidAccess for a legitimately configured host.
